outcome: A creature with toughness above 0 that was dealt any damage by a deathtouch source is destroyed in the next state-based check.
Any nonzero combat damage assigned by a deathtouch source counts as lethal, so the attacker may assign just 1 damage to each blocker and the excess goes on.
A deathtouch source dealing damage from a zone other than the battlefield still destroys the creature it damages.
A source that left its zone before dealing damage is judged by its last known information, so damage from a formerly deathtouch object still destroys the creature.

note: Redundancy of instances has no separate outcome.
